record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: BALTOY (1 star) and CLAYDOL (2 stars), the queued units; maxPP 70, range 2 for both. Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Two-branch single-target cast on the current target. Branch A (target NOT currently confused): the target is silenced and confused for the same requested duration, 3000 / 5000 / 7000 / 10000 ms by caster stars (3000 for BALTOY, 5000 for CLAYDOL); no damage in this branch. Branch B (target ALREADY confused at cast time): no status is applied and the target takes requested special damage 75 / 150 / 300 / 500 by caster stars (75 BALTOY, 150 CLAYDOL) through handleSpecialDamage with the cast's crit flag, so it is scaled by the caster's AP (apBoost default true), a crit factor when the cast crit, and then reduced by the target's special defense in PokemonState.handleDamage. The statuses are applied via triggerSilence / triggerConfusion without AP or crit scaling of the duration (apBoost is not passed, so false). Applied status durations are modified: both are blocked by Rune Protect; silence is also blocked by the tree status and is x1.3 in MURKY weather, confusion is also blocked when the target has the IMMUNITY_CONFUSION effect (Persim Berry) and is x1.3 in SANDSTORM weather; both then pass the Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer reduction and Odd Keystone reduction. A confused unit retargets in the attacking state (50% chance it may pick allies too). Confusion ending clears the target.

targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true, so the caster needs a target in range (range 2) to start the cast. The branch is chosen by target.status.confusion read at cast time.

effects.target: the cast target, only when it is not already confused
effects.scaling: none: triggerSilence(confusionDuration, target, pokemon) receives the table value unchanged; no AP and no crit scaling.
effects.resolution: applied duration: nothing if the target has Rune Protect or the tree status; x1.3 in MURKY weather; then Swift Swim x0.7 or Hydration x0.5 or Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3 (first match), then Odd Keystone x(1 - 0.1 per stone) on the target's player; rounded after the reductions. The status keeps the longer of the old and new cooldown. Applied in the same branch and before triggerConfusion.

effects.target: the cast target, only when it is not already confused
effects.scaling: none: triggerConfusion(confusionDuration, target, pokemon) is called without apBoost (default false), so the origin's AP does not lengthen it.
effects.resolution: applied duration: only applied if the target is not already confused (always true in this branch), has no Rune Protect and no IMMUNITY_CONFUSION effect; x1.3 in SANDSTORM weather; then the Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer and Odd Keystone reductions; Math.round. A Persim Berry holder eats it on being confused (clears the confusion at once, grants IMMUNITY_CONFUSION, heals 50 and +10 special defense). A PSYDUCK-passive target gains 100 AP when confused.

effects.target: the cast target, only when it is already confused
effects.scaling: requested amount: handleSpecialDamage(damage, board, AttackType.SPECIAL, pokemon, crit) with apBoost default true gives damage x(1 + AP/100); crit applies when the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false), reduced to no crit bonus if the target holds Rocky Helmet and lowered by Black Augurite stones of the target's player; DOUBLE_DAMAGE on the caster doubles it once and is consumed; STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT x1.2.
effects.resolution: applied: skipped entirely (spellBlockedCount++, takenDamage 0) if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce (a magicBounce target reflects a special hit back at the caster unless the caster holds Protective Pads). Otherwise PokemonState.handleDamage resolves special defense, shield absorption and the minimum of 1 (shared reference core-mechanics §A); takenDamage reported by handleDamage includes shield damage. A Power Lens holder on the target reflects the blocked portion back to the caster.

statusEffects.who: the cast target when not already confused
statusEffects.combatEffect: canCast is false while silenced, and addPP ignores positive PP gains while silenced

statusEffects.who: the cast target when not already confused
statusEffects.combatEffect: in the attacking state a confused unit picks its target with getTargetWhenConfused (nearest candidates within distance range+1, allies also eligible when a 50% roll fails); when its position equals its target's, board orientation is random; when confusion expires the unit's target is cleared

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the caster's stars (stars-1); the 3-star and 4-star entries (7000/10000 ms, 300/500 damage) and the fallback are not reached by the two listed units.

record.positionalConditions: None positional. The branch depends on whether the target is confused at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state in the strategy. Because a confused target takes the damage branch, a second cast on the same target while confusion lasts deals damage instead of refreshing the status; once confusion has expired the status branch runs again. Silence from the first cast may still be active in the damage branch (it is not re-applied there).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: silence and confusion 3000 ms (BALTOY) / 5000 ms (CLAYDOL), or damage 75 / 150. Applied duration = requested after Murky (silence) or Sandstorm (confusion) weather, Rune Protect / tree / IMMUNITY_CONFUSION blocks, status-duration reductions and Odd Keystone. Applied damage = requested x (1+AP/100) x crit factor, then special-defense reduction, shield absorption and minimum 1 inside handleDamage; takenDamage includes shield damage; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Neither branch heals or buffs.
